hero.description: Deploy and manage 25+ production-grade databases as native Kubernetes resources on Red Hat OpenShift. Run production databases with full automation, governance, and portability across on-prem, cloud, edge, and air-gapped environments.

intro.description: KubeDB by AppsCode delivers a production-grade, Kubernetes-native Database-as-a-Service platform that runs seamlessly on Red Hat OpenShift and OpenShift Virtualization. It enables platform teams and developers to provision, manage, scale, backup, and recover databases using familiar Kubernetes APIs without vendor lock-in while maintaining enterprise-grade security and compliance.

meaning.title: What This Means for Red Hat OpenShift Users
meaning.description: If you're running applications on Red Hat OpenShift, you benefit from enterprise Kubernetes with enhanced security and developer experience. KubeDB extends these benefits to your database layer with native operator patterns.
meaning.emphasis: KubeDB enhances OpenShift by making databases first-class citizens in your platform:

items.title: VM & Container Support

rows.previous: Limited (often 5-10 engines, vendor-specific like Postgres/MySQL via certified operators)
rows.current: 25+ engines including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, Cassandra, Neo4j and more

rows.previous: Console-driven or external service with limited Red Hat OpenShift integration
rows.current: Native CRDs via Operator Lifecycle Manager (OLM). Full declarative GitOps support

rows.previous: Per-core or usage licensing plus egress fees for external DBaaS
rows.current: No licensing fees. Pay only for your Red Hat OpenShift nodes and storage

rows.previous: Minutes to hours, often with manual approval
rows.current: Seconds via kubectl or GitOps with developer self-service
Native ODF Ceph CSI with high performance, snapshots, and erasure coding
Built-in TLS and encryption plus OpenShift RBAC, SELinux, and NetworkPolicy
Deep integration with OpenShift Monitoring and Prometheus
KubeStash integration, ODF snapshots, and point-in-time recovery
Same manifests across Red Hat OpenShift and CNCF-certified Kubernetes

production.title: Production databases. Fully automated on Red Hat OpenShift.
production.description: 25+ database engines with HA, scaling, backup, TLS, monitoring, and GitOps support

cards.title: Run Databases Natively on Red Hat OpenShift
cards.description: KubeDB integrates deeply with Red Hat OpenShift, supporting OpenShift Data Foundation (ODF), CSI drivers, and both containerized and virtualized workloads. Databases run with full security context constraints and enterprise-grade isolation.

cards.title: Enterprise-Grade Security & Compliance
cards.description: Complete data ownership with Red Hat OpenShift's security features including SELinux, seccomp, and Pod Security Admission. Support for air-gapped, FIPS-140-2, and highly regulated environments.

cards.title: Broad Database Support
cards.description: Manage 25+ database engines including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, Kafka, and more, all with consistent Kubernetes-native workflows on both containers and VMs.

cards.title: Automated Lifecycle Management
cards.description: Declarative operators handle provisioning, upgrades, scaling, and repair with zero-downtime where possible.

cards.title: High Availability & Resiliency
cards.description: Multi-zone clustering, automated failover, PodDisruptionBudgets, and continuous health checks with Red Hat OpenShift Operator Hub integration.

cards.title: Backup & Recovery
cards.description: Integrated with KubeStash for policy-driven, incremental, encrypted backups to S3-compatible storage. Support for point-in-time recovery.

cards.title: Monitoring & Observability
cards.description: Native Prometheus + Grafana dashboards. Integrates with Red Hat OpenShift monitoring stack and Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management.

cards.title: Security & Governance
cards.description: Automated TLS, Transparent Data Encryption, RBAC integration with Red Hat OpenShift OAuth, network policies, and Red Hat Compliance Operator support.

cards.title: Legacy Workloads
cards.description: Run databases on Red Hat OpenShift alongside legacy virtualized workloads, Windows applications, or Bare Metal deployments.
